answer: The willow schedule is applied in oasis and delta shows each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 34% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4139 identities would post 4958 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
